description: ECOWAS region - Hydropower potential in Sub-catchment areas is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Hydropower, Renewable energy", published or maintained by ECREEE (ECREEE). This dataset shows subareas (sub-catchments) for West Africa and the estimated hydropower potential as well as several other interesting attributes for hydropower development and climate change projections and impact on hydropower potential. Coverage: 14 countries in Sub-Saharan Africa. It has 2 files in GeoJSON, TILE. The portal files it under Hydropower, Renewable energy, Resource assessments. The portal gives 2016 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
